newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker market quiet with few enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker market quiet with few enquiries.

text.p: Activity was slow in the Singapore bunker market on Monday amid a little-moved cargo market and few enquiries were seen, traders said.

Many players stayed away from the market on a typical Monday while shipowners were not eager to cover their requirements. "The market is pretty quiet. Most sellers are just holding their previous levels," said one trader.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at about $100 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was at around $103.
MDO and gas oil were at around $163 and $175 per tonne respectively, traders said. --Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
